compiled_state.title: Atomic deletion of bootstrap.py + 4 _band.py modules; flip CI scan to enforcing
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-4: Atomic deletion in single commit; static-import-scan across 4 zones returns zero hits

Delete the 5 legacy modules (bootstrap.py, orphan_band.py, duplicates_band.py, stale_band.py, open_count_skew_band.py) from plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/ in single commit. Delete corresponding test files in tests/unit/dso_reconciler/. Flip plugins/dso/scripts/check-deleted-bridge-imports.sh from advisory to enforcing (default exit non-zero on hits; --advisory becomes opt-out). After deletion, scan must return zero hits across all 4 zones.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] All 5 modules removed
  Verify: for f in bootstrap orphan_band duplicates_band stale_band open_count_skew_band; do test ! -f plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/$f.py; done
- [ ] CI scan returns zero hits in enforcing mode
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/scripts/check-deleted-bridge-imports.sh
- [ ] Full-repo ripgrep finds zero live imports of 5 names
  Verify: ! rg -q 'from (bootstrap|orphan_band|duplicates_band|stale_band|open_count_skew_band)|import (bootstrap|orphan_band|duplicates_band|stale_band|open_count_skew_band)' plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/ .github/workflows/ tests/

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/bootstrap.py — Remove
- plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/orphan_band.py — Remove
- plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/duplicates_band.py — Remove
- plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/stale_band.py — Remove
- plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/open_count_skew_band.py — Remove
- plugins/dso/scripts/check-deleted-bridge-imports.sh — Edit

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)

comments.body: REVISION_CYCLE_1 (Step 4 plan review feedback): (a) Run check-deleted-bridge-imports.sh --strict BEFORE deleting any files; only proceed with deletion if scan returns zero hits. (b) Add explicit pre_cutover.py inspection AC: search pre_cutover.py for any dynamic band-module references (string literals matching the 5 names) — not just import statements. Use grep + Python AST inspection. (c) Importlib smoke test AC: `python3 -c 'import plugins.dso.scripts.dso_reconciler.reconcile; import plugins.dso.scripts.dso_reconciler.__main__'` succeeds AFTER deletion (catches runtime importlib refs that ripgrep would miss). (d) Wire script into .github/workflows/reconcile-bridge.yml with --strict as final task-6 step. (e) Test deletions are scoped to ONLY the test files for the 5 deleted modules — preserved tests must still pass.
comments.author: Test

comments.body: REVISION_CYCLE_2 (cycle 2 plan review feedback): Add explicit AC: the story-branch merge commit MUST include the squashed work of tasks 3 + 4 + 5 + 7 together (atomic merge). No individual task commits from this group may be cherry-picked or merged to main before task-6 completes. This is enforced by the story-branch merge protocol — tasks 3-5-7 are non-deployable in isolation.
comments.author: Test

comments.body: FINAL_REMEDIATION: Promote to AC verify lines (move from cycle-1 review comment into the AC checklist): (a) 'pre_cutover.py dynamic-ref check returns zero hits' — Verify: python3 -c 'import ast; src=open("plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/pre_cutover.py").read(); tree=ast.parse(src); hits=[n for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n, ast.Str) and any(name in n.s for name in ["bootstrap","orphan_band","duplicates_band","stale_band","open_count_skew_band"])]; assert not hits, hits'. (b) Importlib smoke test post-deletion — Verify: python3 -c 'import plugins.dso.scripts.dso_reconciler.reconcile; import plugins.dso.scripts.dso_reconciler.__main__'. Migration note for backward_compat (minor): Keep --strict as opt-in (do NOT invert the default). CI workflow invokes the script WITH --strict; local tooling invocations without flags retain advisory-default exit-0 behavior. This preserves backward compatibility of existing local invocations.
comments.author: Test

comments.body: AC amendment (gap analysis): Pre-deletion --strict scan must run against POST-rewrite tree, not pre-rewrite. Required ordering: (1) stage applier rewrite + new leaves + _errors.py, (2) --strict scan against working tree, (3) stage deletions, (4) importlib smoke test, (5) commit. Add fail-fast check: scan invocation while legacy modules still on disk AND applier.py still imports them → abort with clear error. Rationale: wrong ordering causes the atomic merge to fail the --strict gate even when the final tree is clean, blocking the cutover (cross_task_interference).
comments.author: Test
